research.searchCoverage: Official Fly.io Machines API authentication, apps, machines, and tokens/current docs, Fly.io Inc. US identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. The October 2025 CEO Twitter account takeover is a historical non-China social-account incident with no claimed Machines API compromise. This is the pinned Fly.io Machines provider, not fly.com.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Fly.io read operations provide organization app and machine inventory through the official Machines API.
exception.incident: October 2025 phishing of Fly.io CEO Kurt Mackey led to a ~15 hour takeover of the company X/Twitter account. Fly.io reported the event as limited to that social account.
exception.remediation: Password reset plus X.com 2FA recovery after about 15 hours. Fly.io published an incident post and stated platform systems were not at risk beyond the Twitter account.
exception.residualRisk: Social-account phishing remains a historical residual. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official Fly.io Machines API at api.machines.dev, Bearer token auth, Fly.io Inc. Delaware/California identity, and dated Twitter ATO coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. This recipe is the pinned OpenConnector fly provider (Fly.io machines/orgs), not fly.com. Historical non-China social-account incident is recorded; no current unresolved Machines API breach is asserted.

incidents.affectedData: Social account takeover after CEO phishing; Fly.io reported no platform systems at risk beyond the Twitter account.
incidents.remediation: Password reset and X.com 2FA recovery after about 15 hours.
incidents.residualRisk: Social-engineering risk to public accounts remains a historical residual.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

docs.machines.dev prose mentions Authorization: FlyV1; official fly.io docs and the same page's curl examples use Authorization: Bearer, matching the pinned source.
Native category is dev-tools rather than Developer Tools.

app_name and machine_id are URL-encoded path segments. Optional include_leases from OpenAPI is omitted because the pinned get_machine handler does not send it.

apps.get.description: Retrieve one Fly App by name.
apps.get.title: Get app

apps.list.description: List Fly Apps for an organization.
apps.list.title: List apps

healthcheck.description: Validate the Fly.io API token with GET /tokens/current.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

machines.get.description: Retrieve one Fly Machine by app and Machine ID.
machines.get.title: Get machine

machines.list.description: List Fly Machines in an app with optional region, state, and summary filters.
machines.list.title: List machines

tokens.current.title: Get current token info
tokens.current.description: Get information about the current Fly.io authentication token, including organizations, apps, and user or machine restrictions.

orgs.machines.list.title: List organization machines
orgs.machines.list.description: List Machines across all apps in a Fly.io organization, with optional region, state, and time filters.

state.description: Comma-separated states: created, started, stopped, suspended.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

updated_after.description: Only return machines updated after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

platform.placements.title: Get placements
platform.placements.description: Simulate placing Machines into Fly.io regions based on capacity, volume constraints, and organization limits.

count.description: Number of machines to simulate. 0 returns the org-specific limit per region.

region.description: Comma-delimited regions or aliases. Defaults to the API local region with any fallback.

compute.description: Resource requirements for the Machine to simulate.

weights.description: Optional weights to override default placement preferences.

volume_name.description: Name of an existing volume to consider in placement.

volume_size_bytes.description: Volume size in bytes to consider in placement.

platform.regions.title: Get regions
platform.regions.description: List available Fly.io regions, optionally filtered by CPU, memory, GPU, or machine size.

size.description: Guest machine size preset (for example performance-1x).

wireguard.peers.add.title: Add WireGuard peer
wireguard.peers.add.description: Add a WireGuard peer to a Fly.io organization for private network access.

region.description: Region to deploy the peer. Fly chooses one when omitted.

network.description: Network ID to attach the peer to. Defaults to the organization network.

body.query: mutation AddWireGuardPeer($input: AddWireGuardPeerInput!) { addWireGuardPeer(input: $input) { peerip endpointip pubkey network clientMutationId } }

apps.check_name.title: Check app name availability
apps.check_name.description: Validate whether a proposed Fly.io app name is available.

name.description: App name to check. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.

body.query: query AppNameAvailable($name: String!) { appNameAvailable(name: $name) }

check_jobs.list.title: Check jobs
check_jobs.list.description: Execute a GraphQL query against Fly.io checkJobs. Pass a checkJobs query string; optional variables support pagination.

query.description: GraphQL query string executed against the Fly.io GraphQL API.

variables.description: Optional GraphQL variables (first, last, after, before).

body.query: {{query}}

tokens.user_only.title: Check user-only token
tokens.user_only.description: Check whether the authentication token only allows user access. Returns false when the token also allows organization access.

body.query: query UserOnlyToken { userOnlyToken }

check_jobs.create.title: Create health check job
check_jobs.create.description: Create a health check job that monitors a URL from multiple Fly.io locations.

locations.description: Geographic locations such as newyork, london, tokyo.

http_options.description: HTTP options including verb (GET or HEAD) and optional headers.

organization_id.description: Organization ID where the job is created.

body.query: mutation CreateCheckJob($input: CreateCheckJobInput!) { createCheckJob(input: $input) { checkJob { id url schedule nextRunAt } clientMutationId } }

check_jobs.run.title: Create check job run
check_jobs.run.description: Trigger a run of an existing Fly.io health check job.

check_job_id.description: ID of the check job to run.

body.query: mutation CreateCheckJobRun($input: CreateCheckJobRunInput!) { createCheckJobRun(input: $input) { checkJobRun { id state url } clientMutationId } }

wireguard.delegated_tokens.create.title: Create delegated WireGuard token
wireguard.delegated_tokens.create.description: Create a delegated WireGuard token for peer management in a Fly.io organization.

body.query: mutation CreateDelegatedWireGuardToken($input: CreateDelegatedWireGuardTokenInput!) { createDelegatedWireGuardToken(input: $input) { token clientMutationId } }

third_party_configurations.create.title: Create third-party configuration
third_party_configurations.create.description: Create a third-party service configuration for discharging macaroon caveats.

location.description: Location URL of the third-party discharge service.

uiexLevel.description: Caveat level for UI session tokens.

customLevel.description: Caveat level for custom token creation.

flyctlLevel.description: Caveat level for flyctl session tokens.

body.query: mutation CreateThirdPartyConfiguration($input: CreateThirdPartyConfigurationInput!) { createThirdPartyConfiguration(input: $input) { thirdPartyConfiguration { id name location uiexLevel customLevel flyctlLevel } clientMutationId } }

wireguard.delegated_tokens.delete.title: Delete delegated WireGuard token
wireguard.delegated_tokens.delete.description: Delete a delegated WireGuard token. Provide either name or token in addition to organization_id.

name.description: Token name. Provide this or token.

token.description: Raw WireGuard token. Provide this or name.

organization_id.description: Node ID of the organization that owns the token.

body.query: mutation DeleteDelegatedWireGuardToken($input: DeleteDelegatedWireGuardTokenInput!) { deleteDelegatedWireGuardToken(input: $input) { token clientMutationId } }

organizations.delete.title: Delete organization
organizations.delete.description: Permanently delete a Fly.io organization and its associated resources. This cannot be undone.

organizationId.description: Identifier of the organization to delete.

body.query: mutation DeleteOrganization($input: DeleteOrganizationInput!) { deleteOrganization(input: $input) { deletedOrganizationId clientMutationId } }

remote_builders.delete.title: Delete remote builder
remote_builders.delete.description: Delete the remote builder configuration for a Fly.io organization.

organization_id.description: Node ID of the organization whose remote builder should be deleted.

body.query: mutation DeleteRemoteBuilder($input: DeleteRemoteBuilderInput!) { deleteRemoteBuilder(input: $input) { organization { id slug } clientMutationId } }

third_party_configurations.delete.title: Delete third-party configuration
third_party_configurations.delete.description: Delete a third-party service configuration from Fly.io.

third_party_configuration_id.description: Node ID of the third-party configuration to delete.

body.query: mutation DeleteThirdPartyConfiguration($input: DeleteThirdPartyConfigurationInput!) { deleteThirdPartyConfiguration(input: $input) { ok clientMutationId } }

postgres.detach.title: Detach Postgres cluster
postgres.detach.description: Detach a Postgres cluster from a Fly.io application, revoking access credentials.

app_id.description: Application ID that currently has Postgres attached.

postgres_cluster_app_id.description: Postgres cluster application ID to detach.

postgres_cluster_attachment_id.description: Optional attachment ID for the specific attachment to remove.

body.query: mutation DetachPostgresCluster($input: DetachPostgresClusterInput!) { detachPostgresCluster(input: $input) { app { id name } postgresClusterApp { id name } clientMutationId } }

ssh.establish.title: Establish SSH key
ssh.establish.description: Establish an SSH key for a Fly.io organization.

override.description: Replace an existing SSH key when true.

body.query: mutation EstablishSshKey($input: EstablishSSHKeyInput!) { establishSshKey(input: $input) { certificate clientMutationId } }

nodes.list.title: Fetch nodes by IDs
nodes.list.description: Fetch Fly.io GraphQL nodes by ID. Default selection is id and __typename. Optional query_fields is accepted for Composio parity but is not interpolated into the GraphQL document.

query_fields.description: Optional GraphQL fragment. Not sent; default selection is id and __typename.

body.query: query Nodes($ids: [ID!]!) { nodes(ids: $ids) { id __typename } }

add_ons.get.title: Get add-on
add_ons.get.description: Find a Fly.io add-on by ID, name, or provider.

provider.description: Optional provider filter such as upstash or tigris.

body.query: query AddOn($id: ID, $name: String, $provider: String) { addOn(id: $id, name: $name, provider: $provider) { id name status hostname publicUrl createdAt primaryRegion organization { id slug } } }

add_ons.providers.get.title: Get add-on provider
add_ons.providers.get.description: Query a Fly.io add-on provider (extension) by name.

name.description: Provider name such as tigris, sentry, or upstash_redis.

body.query: query AddOnProvider($name: String!) { addOnProvider(name: $name) { id name displayName tosUrl tosAgreement autoProvision asyncProvisioning resourceName } }

apps.details.title: Get app details
apps.details.description: Retrieve Fly.io application details including certificates and configuration via GraphQL.

body.query: query AppDetails($name: String!) { app(name: $name) { id name status hostname createdAt organization { id slug } certificates(first: 20) { nodes { id hostname isConfigured clientStatus createdAt } } config { valid errors } } }

certificates.get.title: Get certificate
certificates.get.description: Retrieve a Fly.io certificate by ID, including hostname and configuration status.

body.query: query Certificate($id: ID!) { certificate(id: $id) { id hostname createdAt isConfigured clientStatus domain } }

images.latest_details.title: Get latest image details
images.latest_details.description: Retrieve digest, registry, repository, tag, and version for the latest tag of an image.

fly_version.description: Optional Fly version used for tag resolution.

body.query: query LatestImageDetails($image: String!, $flyVersion: String) { latestImageDetails(image: $image, flyVersion: $flyVersion) { digest registry repository tag version } }

images.latest_tag.title: Get latest image tag
images.latest_tag.description: Retrieve the latest available image tag for a Fly.io Docker repository.

body.query: query LatestImageTag($repository: String!) { latestImageTag(repository: $repository) }

machines.get_by_id.title: Get machine
machines.get_by_id.description: Get a single Fly.io machine by GraphQL machine ID.

body.query: query Machine($machineId: String!) { machine(machineId: $machineId) { id name state region createdAt updatedAt instanceId app { id name } } }

regions.nearest.title: Get nearest region
regions.nearest.description: Retrieve the nearest Fly.io region to the requesting client based on network location.

body.query: query NearestRegion { nearestRegion { code name latitude longitude gatewayAvailable } }

nodes.get.title: Get node by ID
nodes.get.description: Fetch any Fly.io GraphQL node by globally unique ID. Returns id and __typename.

body.query: query Node($id: ID!) { node(id: $id) { id __typename } }

organizations.get.title: Get organization
organizations.get.description: Find a Fly.io organization by slug.

slug.description: Organization slug such as personal or my-org.

body.query: query Organization($slug: String!) { organization(slug: $slug) { id name slug } }

organizations.personal.title: Get personal organization
organizations.personal.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's personal Fly.io organization, including credit balance and WireGuard peers.

body.query: query PersonalOrganization { personalOrganization { id name slug creditBalance wireGuardPeers(first: 20) { nodes { id name peerip region } } } }

platform.info.title: Get platform information
platform.info.description: Retrieve Fly.io platform regions, VM sizes, and flyctl version.

body.query: query Platform { platform { requestRegion regions { code name latitude longitude gatewayAvailable deprecated } vmSizes { name cpuCores memoryMb memoryGb priceMonth } flyctl { version timestamp } } }

products.list.title: Get products and pricing
products.list.description: Retrieve Fly.io product and price information.

body.query: query Products { products { name type unitLabel tiers { unitAmount upTo } } }

viewer.get.title: Get viewer info
viewer.get.description: Retrieve the authenticated Fly.io user, including avatar, email, creation date, and feature flags. Optional query is accepted for Composio parity; the connector sends a default viewer selection.

query.description: Optional GraphQL query. Default fetches avatarUrl, createdAt, email, and featureFlags.

body.query: query Viewer { viewer { avatarUrl email createdAt featureFlags name } }

ssh.issue_certificate.title: Issue certificate
ssh.issue_certificate.description: Issue an SSH certificate for accessing Fly.io infrastructure.

app_names.description: App names this certificate may access.

principals.description: SSH principals such as fly or root.

body.query: mutation IssueCertificate($input: IssueCertificateInput!) { issueCertificate(input: $input) { certificate clientMutationId } }

add_ons.plans.list.title: List add-on plans
add_ons.plans.list.description: List available Fly.io add-on service plans with cursor pagination.

first.description: Number of items to return from the beginning. Cannot be used with last.

last.description: Number of items to return from the end. Cannot be used with first.

body.query: query AddOnPlans($first: Int, $after: String, $before: String, $last: Int) { addOnPlans(first: $first, after: $after, before: $before, last: $last) { nodes { id name displayName description pricePerMonth } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } totalCount } }

add_ons.list.title: List add-ons
add_ons.list.description: List Fly.io add-ons. Optional query is accepted for Composio parity; the connector sends a default addOns selection. Pass pagination through first/after/before/last.

first.description: Number of items to return from the beginning. Cannot be used with last.

last.description: Number of items to return from the end. Cannot be used with first.

query.description: Optional GraphQL query. Default lists add-ons with id, name, status, hostname, and plan.

variables.description: Optional GraphQL variables. Prefer first/after/before/last on this action.

body.query: query AddOns($first: Int, $after: String, $before: String, $last: Int) { addOns(first: $first, after: $after, before: $before, last: $last) { nodes { id name status createdAt hostname publicUrl addOnPlanName } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } totalCount } }

apps.list_graphql.title: List apps via GraphQL
apps.list_graphql.description: List Fly.io applications with volumes, services, and machines using GraphQL pagination.

first.description: Number of items to return from the beginning. Cannot be used with last.

last.description: Number of items to return from the end. Cannot be used with first.

include_vms.description: Include VM/machine information for each app. Always selected in the default query.

include_volumes.description: Include volume information for each app. Always selected in the default query.

include_services.description: Include service information for each app. Always selected in the default query.

body.query: query Apps($first: Int, $after: String, $before: String, $last: Int) { apps(first: $first, after: $after, before: $before, last: $last) { nodes { id name status hostname volumes { nodes { id name } } services { description internalPort } machines { nodes { id state region } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } totalCount } }

check_jobs.locations.list.title: List check locations
check_jobs.locations.list.description: Retrieve available Fly.io health-check locations, including geographic details and coordinates.

body.query: query CheckLocations { checkLocations { name title country locality state coordinates } }

machines.list_graphql.title: List machines
machines.list_graphql.description: List Fly.io machines via GraphQL with cursor pagination.

first.description: Number of items to return from the beginning. Cannot be used with last.

last.description: Number of items to return from the end. Cannot be used with first.

body.query: query Machines($first: Int, $after: String, $before: String, $last: Int) { machines(first: $first, after: $after, before: $before, last: $last) { nodes { id name state region createdAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } totalCount } }

wireguard.peers.remove.title: Remove WireGuard peer
wireguard.peers.remove.description: Remove a WireGuard peer from a Fly.io organization.

name.description: Name of the WireGuard peer to remove.

body.query: mutation RemoveWireGuardPeer($input: RemoveWireGuardPeerInput!) { removeWireGuardPeer(input: $input) { organization { id slug } clientMutationId } }

organizations.set_apps_v2_default.title: Set Apps V2 default
organizations.set_apps_v2_default.description: Configure whether new apps in an organization use Apps V2 by default.

default_on.description: Whether new apps in this org use Apps V2 by default.

body.query: mutation SetAppsV2DefaultOn($input: SetAppsv2DefaultOnInput!) { setAppsV2DefaultOn(input: $input) { organization { id slug name } clientMutationId } }

third_party_configurations.update.title: Update third-party configuration
third_party_configurations.update.description: Update an existing third-party service configuration for discharging macaroon caveats.

location.description: Location URL of the third-party discharge service.

uiexLevel.description: Caveat level for UI session tokens.

customLevel.description: Caveat level for custom token creation.

flyctlLevel.description: Caveat level for flyctl session tokens.

thirdPartyConfigurationId.description: Node ID of the configuration to update.

body.query: mutation UpdateThirdPartyConfiguration($input: UpdateThirdPartyConfigurationInput!) { updateThirdPartyConfiguration(input: $input) { thirdPartyConfiguration { id name location uiexLevel customLevel flyctlLevel } clientMutationId } }

config.validate.title: Validate config
config.validate.description: Validate a Fly.io app configuration (fly.toml represented as JSON) before deploy.

definition.description: JSON object representing the fly.toml configuration.

body.query: query ValidateConfig($definition: JSON!) { validateConfig(definition: $definition) { valid errors definition } }

wireguard.peers.validate.title: Validate WireGuard peers
wireguard.peers.validate.description: Validate WireGuard peer IP addresses in a Fly.io organization.

peer_ips.description: WireGuard peer IPs, typically IPv6 addresses in the fdaa: range.

body.query: mutation ValidateWireGuardPeers($input: ValidateWireGuardPeersInput!) { validateWireGuardPeers(input: $input) { validPeerIps invalidPeerIps clientMutationId } }
